title: Chapter 118 Immortals And Gods
content:
Chapter 118 Immortals And Gods

Zhong Yu couldn't help being startled when he saw that the new god who had just appeared in the sky was able to directly ignore the protective circle left by him and transmit his coercion into the camp.

This should be the true god that Ryan Kingdom believed in! It is said that this deity came from the outside, and before the belief was popular on the entire plain, it had already condensed the godhead.

Now it is even on the entire plain, with more than 300,000 people enshrining, the strength must be further improved, and it is about to reach the level of Godhead One!

He quickly analyzed the strength of this god in his heart, but Zhong Yu managed to calm his face outside, and turned to look at this god with his sharp eyes. The color of fear.

Seeing the mortal ant below, and seeing that he has such strength without the slightest panic, the Ruien God of Ruien Kingdom who just appeared above the sky has a bad premonition in his heart.

Could it be that this ant has other methods that are useless? how can that be?

Being able to hurt some demigods is already the limit of what you can know. How can you cause any harm to yourself, a truly immortal god?

Thinking of this, God Ryan said a few words of comfort in his heart, but his face turned hard, and he quickly slapped down with both hands, making up his mind to hit this person before he released his ultimate move. kill.

I saw that as Ryan's hands were photographed, a huge and incomparable handprint struck quickly, just like the Tathagata palm photographed by A Xing in the movie Kung Fu, but it was even bigger and more powerful than the Tathagata palm.

The handprint was glowing with golden light, piercing Cao Cao and others who looked up at him, and many soldiers had painful eyes and tears, and quickly lowered their heads to wipe, closed their eyes and recovered.

Zhong Yu was not affected at all, maybe it was difficult to resist this force with his own strength, but it was still possible to be immune to the suppression of this force.

Seeing such a decisive action by God Rui En, Zhong Yu's complexion couldn't help but change. He was not slow in his hands, and quickly mobilized the Eye of Heaven and the Manifestation of Humanity to delay time together.

There was a crackling sound, and as one after another thunderbolt hit the handprint, the handprint gradually became smaller, gradually changed from solid to illusory, and finally slapped heavily on the defense formed by the manifestation of humanity. lock up.

There was a rumbling sound, and as the ground shook, the whole ground shook. Cao Cao and the others accidentally fell and fell to the ground in embarrassment.

However, the defensive circle formed by the manifestation of humanity stood there solidly. It only shook a few times violently, but it still stood there firmly, without any major hindrance.

But Zhong Yu knew that such a block would consume 1/10 of humanity's power. If that Ryan god comes again a few times, or if the power is stronger, then I really can't hold it!

Seeing that his strength could not be stopped, and even repelled the God of Ryan, Zhong Yu's face turned hard, it seemed that he was about to use his trump card, and he had been preparing to use it to deal with these gods, wasn't he just waiting for this moment?

100,000 luck points, in order to be safe for this moment, I have saved up 100,000 luck points, even if it is my entire imperial country, it needs the support of luck points to run, and I am reluctant to touch this A little bit of luck is reserved just in case this moment comes!

"System, I want to use 100,000 luck points to summon an eighth-level character to help me!"

It turned out that when Zhong Yu was about to send troops to conquer the Lost Plain, just in case, he asked the system in advance, and if he couldn't exchange for an existence above a demigod to work for him, then what else could he do to protect him? Your own life is safe?

The system gave an answer, Zhong Yu can use luck points to summon the god-level creatures already in the system to help him resist the threats he faces.

But there are only three opportunities, and it takes a lot of luck points to maintain the survival and attack of these existences, because these existences are already dead.

However, the system signed a contract at the moment before death, promising them to be resurrected for a short period of time at a certain moment, but they must help the person who resurrected them to complete the task assigned by that person within this period of time.

And what Zhong Yu summoned now was the lowest level of assistance. The person who made the move had just reached the immortal level, but he had to aggrieve to become a fairy because he had consumed too much power and lost too much foundation.

It is precisely because of this that in order to be able to use the immortal power he dreamed of and experience the feeling of being an immortal, he agreed to the system's condition to help the person who summoned him, precisely to fulfill his last wish!

As Zhong Yu's words fell, there was a gust of wind and cloud in the sky, and there was a rage of thunder. It seemed that there would be some very terrible scenes before there would be a warning from heaven.

An extremely terrifying coercion came, and I felt it carefully, but found that there seemed to be an extremely terrifying existence that was about to be born, but I didn't know how it existed.

Countless ants on the ground ran away, and the beasts fled in shock. All the birds in the sky couldn't bear it, and fell down like rain, falling directly into a piece of meat.

Within a radius of ten miles, all the air was solidified by this coercion, and all people, animals, and objects could not move.

Many soldiers including Zhong Yu's camp, although they have the protective place capable of manifesting humane will, are a little bit better, they don't lie on the ground directly, they can barely stand, but they are all in a mess, almost falling down!

The god above the sky is better. Although he feels oppressed by the frozen atmosphere, his actions are completely fine, and it does not affect his display of strength.

But God Ryan also felt panic because of this sudden coercion. Could it be that the coercion was issued by the backstage of the mortal emperor in front of him?

That's why he was so unscrupulous, killing so many demigods at will must be the method of that terrifying existence!

Thinking of this in my heart, I became more and more terrified. With this coercion, I concluded that I was far from being an opponent. I'm afraid it is the strength of a weak god with a rank of three or even four. I am only a weak god with a rank of zero, and my strength is too far apart.

Just when Ryan realized that the development of the situation was far beyond his imagination, he had completely lost control, and he was no longer able to absolutely control the entire situation, and planned to run away.

But suddenly found that not far from him, a figure appeared in the sky above the mortal emperor, wearing a strange white shirt, with fluttering sleeves, and the sound of the wind, a sense of immortality came leisurely .

He fixed his eyes and saw that the white-clothed man had a handsome face, and his brows were furrowed, showing a hint of pain. But there is infinite majesty emanating from it, making people dare not despise this person because of his face, but full of awe.
